title: Rewards of Honor: A Heart That Changes the World
description: In this powerful message, Pastor Chris Zehner explores the often-overlooked yet crucial topic of honor in our lives, relationships, and society. He delves into the rewards and benefits of honoring our parents, spouses, leaders, and authority, and challenges listeners to examine the state of their hearts and homes in light of God's Word. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the life-changing principles of honor and how it can bring blessings, peace, and prosperity into every area of your life.
